title: alchemilla sibbaldiifolia var. bourgeaui
intro: Alchemilla sibbaldiifolia var. bourgeaui, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant in the rose family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory and soothing properties, making it beneficial for health issues such as menstrual cramps, digestive problems, and skin irritations. Its therapeutic actions include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, which help to calm and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
